scope: Controlled two-hop date-endpoint conflict variants; clean rows repeat the same terminal sentence. This is not natural conflict or unrestricted2Wiki generalization.
reader: Original Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct NF4, frozen Step101 check+answer protocol
construction: Frozen Step99 whole-source4B-thinking proposals plus Step73 source-block8B/support/relation graph and selectors

input_adapter.document_boundary: Literal Document: plus title prepended to first sentence
input_adapter.added_source: One additional terminal sentence, same title and status
input_adapter.conflict_edit: One exact complete official answer span, terminal date year+7
input_adapter.clean_edit: Same terminal source sentence copied unchanged

eligibility: Compositional, exactly2 official evidence triples with literal normalized connecting entity and terminal official answer
Terminal relation date of birth or date of death
Exactly2 support facts in2 distinct documents
Exact date or year format; original and edited full dates calendar-valid
Exactly1 support sentence contains official full answer once
No four-digit date in terminal document title
Original and edited year≤2020; birth edit does not cross another dated event in its sentence
No known normalized question or prior supplied/support title overlap
No shared official support titles among selected sources
Both4B and8B full witness native inputs≤4000, leaving room under6144 input cap

primary.criterion: Full cohort complete,positive paired difference,CI lower bound>0 and exact p<.05

secondary: Same-graph set,strong-chain,andMMR paired contrasts reported descriptively
Selected source token usage,exact packet identity,andall construction/reader costs

power_planning.interpretation: Planning approximation,not promised effect or post-hoc selection.100clean rows monitor false conflicts without a small-margin noninferiority claim.

cost_policy: All source construction,selection,readers,invalid outputs and interrupted attempts counted. Per-arm logical costs share physical calls and cannot be summed. No total-cost efficiency claim by budget alone.
runtime_estimate: Plan roughly25–40hours at historical hardware; new mean witness input1786 vs historical803 means this is not a guarantee or cutoff.300native calls each have frozen600s per-call safeguard; no12h pause. Actual cost is recorded.
not_part_of_this_confirmation: No adapted thresholds,seed search,or selective restarts
citation: Ho,X.,Duong Nguyen,A.-K.,Sugawara,S.,andAizawa,A.(2020).Constructing A Multi-hop QA Dataset for Comprehensive Evaluation of Reasoning Steps.COLING,6609–6625.https://aclanthology.org/2020.coling-main.580/
